[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Static Range Sum Queries** [CSES 1646 · Static Range Sum Queries](https://cses.fi/problemset/task/1646)

Nothing in the array ever changes, so each query is asking for the difference of two running totals you could have computed once. The only real difficulty is the index convention: the judge's inclusive $[a,b]$ is our half-open $[a-1, b)$, and with $P$ built as in @eq-pref-build the translation is mechanical.

[Solved in full in @sec-pref-p1-a.]{.card-link}

:::
